content.title: 2026 EVENT: Easter Egg Hunts (March 21-22, 28-29, April 2-5) - Green Meadows Petting Farm
content.text: EASTER EGG HUNTS ATGREEN MEADOWS FARM March 21-22, 28-29 and April 2-5Admission is $18 for ages 2 and Up (babies are free)CREDIT ONLYOpen, Weather Permitting Easter Egg Hunts at Green Meadows Farm! We have three weekends of Easter Egg Hunts! Purchase your admission to the farm/hunts on our website (link below) or when you arrive. Below is some information about our hunts. This information may be updated as details come in so please check back on this page before you come to our egg hunts. Easter Egg Hunt Details – Subject to Change! • Hunts will be happening throughout the day, between 10:30 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. We will have candy-filled eggs to hunt for. The petting farm closes at 4:30 p.m. – last admission will be at 3:00 p.m. so don’t be late! • Egg Hunt Areas are sectioned off according to ages.• Hunters in ages 5 to 12 group will be in a timed hunt. • Hunters in ages 4 and under will not be timed, however, we will limit the number of families that can hunt at one time. • NO strollers, wagons, etc. are allowed in hunt areas.• Please open eggs after your child leaves the hunt area so that others have time to hunt too. • Each child may participate in one hunt daily. • The Easter Egg Hunt is free and part of your child’s $18.00 admission to the petting farm on our Hunt days. • Walk our Easter Trail to see the Easter Bunny. Lots of great photo opportunities as you walk the Trail!• Bring your own Easter basket or purchase one from us for $5.00 (while supplies last). More Information:Vendors:Green Meadows Food Barn – All daysIn10se and Snowies – all days except April 2Weekend Only Vendors:Oh Holy SweetsTigers & Unicorns Oh My Face PaintingEmilia Ear ArtDogwood Creations Be sure to check back regularly as our Easter Egg Hunt information may change as we get closer to our opening. No reservations will be taken, just pay your admission at our gate when you arrive or purchase a ticket in advance using the link below. Admission is $18.00 per person for ages 2 and older. The cost includes the free hunt as well as our regular petting farm fun (friendly animals, hayride, free animal feed, pig races, etc.). Our farm opens at 10:00 am and we allow admissions until 3:00 pm (we close at 4:30 pm). Buy Ticket for Farm Visit
